messages.content: Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?

function.name: science_history_get_invention

message.content:
The theory of relativity was formulated by **Albert Einstein**.  
- **Special Theory of Relativity** – published in **1905**.  
- **General Theory of Relativity** – published in **1915**.
